azami_spatial_evidence: Higher annual precipitation BIO12 aligns with a larger signed image-axis angle among taxa: beta=0.304359; q=0.021; broad-space beta=0.286086; P=0.017; direction retained in all 52 audited historical-placement trees
eazami_relative_timing: Mixed internal-to-terminal admissible placement; ML mean relative lineage-depth interval=0.7667-1.0000; UFBoot median lower-upper envelope=0.7952-0.9943; not calendar time
eazami_present_ecology: Downward-minus-upward BIO15 is positive in the GBIF primary and both Taiwan source tiers; effect direction is stable while the threshold class is occurrence-source sensitive
mechanism_prior: External orientation manipulations make reproductive wetting; solar exposure; thermal presentation and effective pollination plausible; focal Japanese Cirsium mechanism remains untested
fitness_evidence: External studies include reproductive-performance effects, but no ancestry-matched focal Japanese orientation-to-filled-achene path is available
reason_for_difference_or_gap: BIO12 measures present spatial rainfall amount whereas BIO15 measures present niche seasonality; agreement is at the hydric-domain level and could reflect mean exposure versus temporal concentration rather than one replicated coefficient
allowed_claim: Repeated orientation change and independent spatial/current-niche hydric correspondences make hydric exposure the strongest current public-data selection-pressure candidate
forbidden_upgrade: rain adaptation demonstrated; ancestral climate matching; adaptive convergence; event-specific causation
next_decisive_test: Map admissible transition edges to an exact dated-tree crosswalk; test BIO12/BIO15 level and variability in transition windows; then manipulate gravity-referenced orientation with flowering-period wetting; pollen performance and filled achenes

azami_spatial_evidence: The broad-space within-taxon orientation-BIO1 relationship is positive; BIO1 is not one of the two robust among-taxon Azami candidates
eazami_relative_timing: Same mixed internal-to-terminal orientation history; exact event ages unavailable
eazami_present_ecology: Downward-minus-upward BIO1 is negative across the frozen East-Asian occurrence tiers
mechanism_prior: Thermal timing and floral temperature are plausible performance pathways, but BIO1 can also proxy elevation; snow; growing season and correlated hydric regimes
reason_for_difference_or_gap: Azami estimates within-taxon present gradients whereas EAzami compares states among lineages; opposite signs can arise from biological scale; correlated mountain-climate packages; image orientation error or different causal pathways
allowed_claim: Temperature remains a competing or interacting axis whose effect is scale dependent under current data
forbidden_upgrade: universal cold-climate downward-head adaptation; direct thermal selection inferred from BIO1
next_decisive_test: Use flowering-season temperature and snow/rain exposure; estimate within-lineage and among-lineage effects on a matched ancestry panel; test thermal mediation experimentally

azami_spatial_evidence: No final Azami among-taxon orientation-RSDS or pollinator candidate passed the sequential candidate gate

reason_for_difference_or_gap: A plausible function need not leave a detectable global mean-gradient signal; pollinator communities and radiation during anthesis are not represented by annual climate centroids

forbidden_upgrade: pollinator-mediated convergence; UV adaptation; visitation treated as fitness

eazami_relative_timing: Continuous colour units have no corrected two-sided phylogenetic-structure support in the present Japan panel; a repeated colour-event count and event placement are not admitted

mechanism_prior: Pollinator choice; visible/UV optical properties and pigment physiology are plausible, but the JPEG chroma endpoint does not identify pigment concentration or UV pattern
reason_for_difference_or_gap: Strong present spatial sorting can coexist with temporal lability; low power; species-tip colour polymorphism or measurement mismatch. Current data cannot distinguish these explanations
allowed_claim: Radiative environment is a strong cause candidate for present visible-colour sorting, but its role in repeated colour evolution is unresolved
forbidden_upgrade: anthocyanin mediation demonstrated; UV adaptation; colour regain; repeated radiative adaptation
next_decisive_test: Recover population-matched calibrated visible/UV colour and pigment chemistry on the dated ancestry panel; only then reconstruct W/C or continuous regime shifts and test event-window radiation

azami_spatial_evidence: Stickiness is not a calibrated continuous endpoint in the frozen Azami handoff
